text.source: 音频设备中断，已完成录制片段保留，可重新导出。
text.translation: The audio device was interrupted. Completed segments are preserved and can be exported again.

text.source: 音频设备未响应停止请求；素材保留，请重试。
text.translation: The audio device did not respond to the stop request. Recorded material is preserved; try again.

text.source: 预览支持标题、列表、表格、公式和服务配图；Word 中公式保留 LaTeX 源码。
text.translation: Preview supports headings, lists, tables, formulas, and service images. Word exports keep formulas as LaTeX source.

text.source: 预览需要 1–4096 字符的 LaTeX 公式。
text.translation: The preview requires a LaTeX formula of 1–4096 characters.

text.source: 预设选区超出当前桌面，请调整位置或尺寸。
text.translation: The preset region is outside the current desktop. Adjust its position or size.

text.source: 首帧已保留，请回到原窗口缓慢滚动，再采集。
text.translation: First frame kept. Return to the original window, scroll slowly, then capture again.
The default action settings are invalid.

text.source: 默认显示截图光标（` 临时切换）
text.translation: Show capture cursor by default (` toggles temporarily)

text.source: 默认行为可在截图设置中调整
text.translation: Adjust the default behavior in Screenshot settings

text.source: 鼠标关闭钉图需要确认
text.translation: Confirm closing a pin by mouse

text.source: 鼠标穿透时显示救援工具栏
text.translation: Show a rescue toolbar in click-through mode

text.source: 鼠标穿透（控制台 / 托盘可解除）
text.translation: Click-through (disable from the main window / tray)

text.source: 鼠标组合重复，请为每个动作设置不同组合。
text.translation: Mouse bindings overlap. Choose a different gesture for each action.

text.source: 工具栏默认工具配置无效。
text.translation: The toolbar default tool configuration is invalid.

text.source: 工具栏默认工具未保存。
text.translation: The toolbar default tool was not saved.

text.source: 鼠标移动时自动框住光标下的窗口或 UI 元素，点击选中；Tab 切换元素 / 窗口。
text.translation: Frame the window or UI element under the pointer as it moves; click to select. Tab switches between elements and windows.

text.source: 点击工具栏分组图标直接使用当前默认工具；右侧箭头或右键切换，选择会记住。
text.translation: Click a toolbar group icon to use its current default tool; use the right arrow or right-click to switch. The choice is remembered.

text.source: 请滚动选区内容，自动拼接；完成后选择输出。
text.translation: Scroll the selected content to stitch automatically; choose an output when finished.

text.source: 首帧已采集，请滚动内容。
text.translation: First frame captured; scroll the content.
Cleared; waiting for the first frame.

text.source: 已有拼接结果，重新开始后可切换方向。
text.translation: Stitching already started; restart to change direction.

text.source: 下一次采集按 {0} px 重叠拼接。
text.translation: The next capture will use {0} px overlap.

text.source: 重叠像素请输入正整数。
text.translation: Overlap must be a positive integer.

text.source: 拖动框选 · Enter 使用此区域 · Esc 取消
text.translation: Drag to select · Enter uses this region · Esc cancels

text.source: 拖动框选 · Enter 复制 · Ctrl+T 钉图 · Ctrl+S 保存 · G 录屏 · Space 工具栏 · Esc 取消
text.translation: Drag to select · Enter copies · Ctrl+T pins · Ctrl+S saves · G records · Space toggles the toolbar · Esc cancels

text.source: 左键双击固定为复制当前图并关闭；上方动作仅用于滚轮与中键。
text.translation: Left double-click always copies the current image and closes the pin; the actions above apply to the wheel and middle button only.

text.source: 显示 / 隐藏选中边框
点击同类标注重新编辑 · Alt 拖动复制 · Delete 删除
text.translation: Click a matching annotation to edit · Alt-drag to copy · Delete to remove

text.source: 工具子操作栏样式配置无效。
text.translation: Tool options style configuration is invalid.

text.source: 拖动框选 · Enter 开始录制 · Esc 取消
text.translation: Drag to select · Enter starts recording · Esc cancels

text.source: 选择保存录屏的文件夹
text.translation: Choose a folder to save the recording

text.source: 开始与结束秒、裁剪、画质和音量用于重新编码；无改动时保存会直接复制原文件。
text.translation: Start/end time, crop, quality, and volume are used when re-encoding; saving without changes copies the original file.

text.source: 保存 / 导出后关闭回放编辑器
text.translation: Close the playback editor after saving / exporting

text.source: 录制格式（可在设置中修改）
剪贴板暂时不可用，请稍后重试。
text.translation: The clipboard is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
